arXiv:2609.11636v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 9 月 10 日arXiv:2609.11636v1 [cs.AI] 10 Sep 2026

MAPLE：记忆增强规划MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning 与语言和进化论with Language and Evolution  研究Research https://github.com/xin8coder/MAPLEMM     应用Application https://github.com/xin8coder/MAPLE-harness-core  现场演示Live demo https://xin8coder.github.io/MAPLE-harness/

Kesheng Chen    Yamin Hu    Wenjian Luo Affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China
摘要Abstract

领域从业者了解他们的业务限制，但可能缺乏运筹学专业知识或专门支持。基于 LLM 的优化代理将自然语言需求转换为已建立的优化工具可以执行的模型或求解器程序。这一进展使优化变得更加容易，但现实世界的操作是动态的：不断变化的需求、资源和优先级需要更新数据、约束和目标。以孤立请求为中心的方法为快速适应提供有限的支持，从而保留早期决策并重用有用的搜索结果。我们引入了 MAPLE（语言和进化的记忆增强规划），它是一种通过连续的自然语言请求来维护优化问题的代理。 MAPLE 将基于语言的问题构建与数学编程和进化搜索相结合。它保留优化计划、已接受的计划、早期更新以及后续请求的候选解决方案。我们引入了 NLDO，这是一个包含 15 个轨迹和 180 个更新的基准，涵盖选择、调度、排班、路由和云资源放置。在主要评估中，MAPLE 完成了所有轨迹，并实现了 0.951 的在线标量质量和 0.875 的 Pareto 超体积比。受控比较进一步表明，维护可执行状态可以提高更新有效性，并且可以在重大修订中保留有用的搜索信息。Domain practitioners understand their business constraints but may lack operations-research expertise or dedicated support. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language requirements into models or solver programs that established optimization tools can execute. This progress makes optimization more accessible, but real-world operations are dynamic: changing demand, resources, and priorities require updates to data, constraints, and objectives. Methods centered on isolated requests offer limited support for rapid adaptation that preserves earlier decisions and reuses useful search results. We introduce MAPLE (Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution), an agent for maintaining optimization problems through successive natural-language requests. MAPLE combines language-based problem construction with mathematical programming and evolutionary search. It retains the optimization program, accepted plans, earlier updates, and candidate solutions for subsequent requests. We introduce NLDO, a benchmark of 15 trajectories and 180 updates spanning selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement. In the main evaluation, MAPLE completes all trajectories and achieves online scalar quality of 0.951 and a Pareto hypervolume ratio of 0.875. Controlled comparisons further show that maintaining executable state improves update validity and can preserve useful search information across substantial revisions.

1 简介Introduction

领域从业者了解运营要求，但可能缺乏运营研究培训或专家支持。生产计划员、调度员、劳动力协调员和基础设施运营商必须将这些要求转化为优化模型，并维护解决这些问题的软件。这种专业知识障碍限制了优化方法的日常采用Domain practitioners understand operational requirements but may lack operations research training or specialist support. Production planners, dispatchers, workforce coordinators, and infrastructure operators must translate these requirements into optimization models and maintain the software that solves them. This expertise barrier limits everyday adoption of optimization methods(AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025)。基于 LLM 的优化代理将自然语言描述转换为模型或求解器代码，并使用已建立的优化包执行它们。一些系统使用执行错误来修改生成的模型或程序. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language descriptions into models or solver code and execute them with established optimization packages. Some systems use execution errors to revise the generated model or program(AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2025; Thind et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025)。最近的系统要求用户澄清规划问题并根据业务数据构建优化模型. More recent systems ask users to clarify the planning problem and build optimization models from business data(Xie, 2026)。这些系统将领域从业者与优化工具连接起来。. These systems connect domain practitioners to optimization tools.

现实世界的运营是动态的：新订单到达、资源变得不可用以及优先级发生变化。仅靠模型生成并不能确保快速、一致的适应。保留先前讨论的客户的车辆分配需要代理修改程序，恢复该决定，并评估早期候选者是否仍然有用。Real-world operations are dynamic: new orders arrive, resources become unavailable, and priorities change. Model generation alone cannot ensure rapid, consistent adaptation. Keeping a previously discussed customer’s vehicle assignment requires the agent to revise the program, recover that decision, and assess whether earlier candidates remain useful.

相关工作从不同方向解决了此设置的部分内容。多轮计划基准研究计划如何随着新约束的到来而变化Related work addresses parts of this setting from different directions. Multi-turn planning benchmarks study how plans change as new constraints arrive(Oh et al., 2025)。其他基于 LLM 的优化方法解决非线性问题和多目标搜索. Other LLM-based optimization methods address nonlinear problems and multi-objective search(Thind et al., 2025; Schwanke et al., 2026)。与此同时，动态优化长期以来一直在研究不断变化的目标和约束条件下的种群修复、转移和重启. Dynamic optimization, meanwhile, has long studied population repair, transfer, and restart under changing objectives and constraints(Branke, 2002; Nguyen et al., 2012)。我们解决了现实操作中的实际差距：使可执行的优化程序适应不断变化的自然语言要求，同时保留已接受的决策并重用相关的搜索状态。我们将此设置称为实时动态优化。. We address a practical gap in real-world operations: adapting executable optimization programs to evolving natural-language requirements while preserving accepted decisions and reusing relevant search state. We call this setting live dynamic optimization.

MAPLE 维护可执行的优化程序（工作台）、输入数据、接受的计划、更新记录和候选解决方案。在初始化时，类型化搜索空间脚手架 (TSS) 让模型定义决策和评估，同时系统提供搜索操作和求解器。它支持线性公式的数学规划、非线性或组合目标的进化搜索以及竞争目标的帕累托搜索。对于后续请求，实时问题分解 (LPD) 会识别受修订影响的输入数据或工作台功能。实时状态内存 (LSM) 从早期更新和已接受的计划中检索信息。当请求要求保留较早的分配时，系统会在下一次搜索期间强制执行该分配。对于进化搜索，重新启动选择器会读取更改摘要并评估较早的候选者是否仍然有用。修复检查，然后选择修复历史初始化（热）或全新初始化（完整）。仅在可执行文件和输出检查通过后才会提交修改后的状态。MAPLE maintains an executable optimization program (the Workbench), input data, accepted plans, update records, and candidate solutions. At initialization, Typed Search-Space Scaffolding (TSS) lets the model define decisions and evaluation, while the system supplies search operations and solvers. It supports mathematical programming for linear formulations, evolutionary search for nonlinear or combinatorial objectives, and Pareto search for competing objectives. For subsequent requests, Live Problem Decomposition (LPD) identifies the input data or Workbench functions affected by the revision. Live State Memory (LSM) retrieves information from earlier updates and accepted plans. When a request asks to keep an earlier assignment, the system enforces that assignment during the next search. For evolutionary search, a restart selector reads a summary of the changes and assesses whether earlier candidates remain useful. Fixed checks then select repaired-history initialization (Warm) or fresh initialization (Full). The revised state is committed only after executable and output checks pass.

我们在 NLDO 上评估 MAPLE，这是一个受控基准，包含 15 个轨迹和 180 个自然语言更新，涉及选择、调度、排班、路由和云资源放置。 NLDO 提供单目标和多目标任务，并独立于结果计划的质量来评估轨迹连续性。在主要评估中，MAPLE 完成了所有轨迹，达到了 0.951 的在线标量质量和 0.875 的 Pareto 超体积比。组件和重新启动控件进一步检查可执行状态维护如何影响有效性、历史基础和跨修订的重用。We evaluate MAPLE on NLDO, a controlled benchmark containing 15 trajectories and 180 natural-language updates across selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement. NLDO provides both single- and multi-objective tasks and evaluates trajectory continuity separately from the quality of the resulting plans. In the main evaluation, MAPLE completes all trajectories, reaching online scalar quality of 0.951 and Pareto hypervolume ratio of 0.875. The component and restart controls further examine how executable-state maintenance affects validity, historical grounding, and reuse across revisions.

我们的贡献是三重的。首先，我们将实时动态优化制定为累积自然语言修订下的优化，并引入 NLDO，具有单目标和多目标任务的静态和动态视图。其次，我们开发了 MAPLE，这是一种可执行状态架构，集成了问题构建、可接受的决策、历史基础和可重用的数值搜索状态。第三，我们评估了完整的代理工作流程和受控变体，表明持久的可执行状态提高了连续性和有效性，同时允许有用的搜索信息在重大修订中幸存下来。Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate live dynamic optimization as optimization under cumulative natural-language revisions and introduce NLDO, with static and dynamic views of single- and multi-objective tasks. Second, we develop MAPLE, an executable-state architecture that integrates problem construction, accepted decisions, historical grounding, and reusable numerical search state. Third, we evaluate complete agent workflows and controlled variants, showing that persistent executable state improves continuity and validity while allowing useful search information to survive substantial revisions.

3 方法Method

MAPLE 分两个阶段运行：构建初始可执行状态并在请求到达时对其进行修改。 TSS 在构建过程中将模型的决策声明连接到固定的搜索操作和求解器（图MAPLE operates in two stages: constructing an initial executable state and revising it as requests arrive. TSS connects the model’s decision declarations to fixed search operations and solvers during construction (Figure2）。对于以后的请求，LPD 找到所需的编辑，LSM 解析对已接受历史记录的引用。重新开始选择决定了进化搜索是重用早期的候选者还是重新开始。固定运行时在提交更新状态之前检查程序和求解器输出（图). For later requests, LPD locates the required edits and LSM resolves references to accepted history. Restart selection determines whether evolutionary search reuses earlier candidates or starts afresh. The fixed runtime checks the program and solver output before committing the updated state (Figure3).

TSS：将决策类型与问题语义绑定。TSS: bind decision types to problem semantics.

模型写道The model writes构建问题（公共上下文）build_problem(public_context)读取公共表、构建评估数据并声明求解器模式、目标和决策部分。段包含二元、分类、有界整数、有界实数、排列或赋值决策；段组成了一个类型化的候选者。to read public tables, construct evaluation data, and declare solver mode, objectives, and decision segments. A segment contains binary, categorical, bounded integer, bounded real, permutation, or assignment decisions; segments compose a typed candidate.评估（基因组，数据）evaluate(genome, data)将候选者解码为计划并返回目标值和约束违规情况。decodes the candidate into a plan and returns objective values and constraint violations.

声明类型会绑定其固定的初始化、交叉、变异和域修复运算符。 真实向量使用模拟二元交叉和多项式变异Declaring a type binds its fixed initialization, crossover, mutation, and domain-repair operators. Real vectors use simulated binary crossover and polynomial mutation(Deb et al., 2002)。 排列使用顺序交叉和交换突变. Permutations use order crossover and swap mutation(Davis, 1985)，而离散向量和分配使用基因明智的亲本选择和类型有效突变, while discrete vectors and assignments use gene-wise parent choice and type-valid mutation(Holland, 1975; Syswerda, 1989).

所有四个运算符都保留声明的表示空间All four operators preserve the declared representation space𝒳⁡(Wt,Dt)\mathcal{X}(W_{t},D_{t}); 评估（）evaluate()检查问题约束。 声明的公式选择求解器。对于线性和混合整数线性问题，固定接口根据变量、边界、目标系数和约束构建模型，然后从返回的变量值中提取请求的计划checks problem constraints. The declared formulation selects the solver. For linear and mixed-integer linear problems, the fixed interface builds a model from variables, bounds, objective coefficients, and constraints, then extracts the requested plan from returned variable values(Dantzig, 1963; Nemhauser and Wolsey, 1988)。标量非线性或组合任务使用 GA. Scalar nonlinear or combinatorial tasks use GA(Holland, 1975)，并且单独的目标使用 NSGA-II, and separate objectives use NSGA-II(Deb et al., 2002)。进化循环评估候选者，选择父母，应用变异和修复，并更新种群和帕累托集；停止使用工作台搜索进度。. The evolutionary loop evaluates candidates, selects parents, applies variation and repair, and updates the population and Pareto set; stopping uses Workbench search progress.

路由示例（图Routing example (Figure2). 构建问题（）build_problem()读取仓库、订单、车辆和策略表，保留活动订单和可用车辆，并声明两个决策段。一项作业reads the depot, order, vehicle, and policy tables, keeps active orders and available vehicles, and declares two decision segments. An assignmentaia_{i}选择每个订单的车辆；排列selects each order’s vehicle; a permutationπ\pi指定访问顺序。分配初始化和变异样本允许车辆，而交叉则从父级继承每个订单的车辆。排列使用洗牌、顺序交叉和交换，将每个活动顺序保留一次。任务修复纠正无效的车辆选择。specifies visit order. Assignment initialization and mutation sample allowed vehicles, while crossover inherits each order’s vehicle from a parent. Permutations use shuffling, order crossover, and swaps, retaining each active order exactly once. Assignment repair corrects invalid vehicle choices.

评估（）evaluate()订单分组依据groups orders byaia_{i} in π\pi每辆二手车都进入一个仓库到仓库的路线。它累积欧几里德距离，模拟出行、等待和迟到服务，并计算距离排放、车辆排放率和碳乘数。产能过剩、晚班返工和订单缺失都会导致约束违规。它将路线和三个目标返回到固定的 NSGA-II 循环。order into one depot-to-depot route per used vehicle. It accumulates Euclidean distance, simulates travel, waiting, and service for lateness, and computes emissions from distance, the vehicle emission rate, and carbon multiplier. Capacity excess, late shift return, and missing orders produce constraint violations. It returns routes and three objectives to the fixed NSGA-II loop.

LPD：找到所请求的修订版。LPD: locate the requested revision.

LPD 读取公共更新、决策声明、存储的事件和接受的结果，以识别数据、决策、评估逻辑或历史绑定的更改。系统直接应用提供的表编辑。当仅用语言描述更改时，模型会将其转换为对输入表的编辑。编辑器接收请求的工作台函数并保留其余函数。因此，价格变化可以单独更新表格，而新的约束可能需要评估编辑。LPD reads the public update, decision declarations, stored events, and accepted result to identify changes to data, decisions, evaluation logic, or historical bindings. The system applies supplied table edits directly. When a change is described only in language, the model translates it into edits to the input tables. The editor receives the requested Workbench functions and preserves the remaining functions. A price change can therefore update the tables alone, while a new constraint may require an evaluation edit.

LSM：将请求绑定到已接受的历史记录。LSM: bind requests to accepted history.

LSM 存储事件、接受的决策和搜索候选者。对于保留先前提到的客户的分配的请求，事件识别客户并且接受的计划供应车辆。类型化绑定查询检索此关系并根据当前决策域对其进行检查。运行时在搜索期间强制执行已解析的分配。接受更新后，事件将添加到提交的历史记录中。 有关早期分配的请求使用先前已接受状态中的一个已保存计划。完整的帕累托集单独存储。在记录的运行中，保存的计划是最终 NSGA-II 选择返回的第一个候选计划。LSM stores events, accepted decisions, and search candidates. For a request to preserve the assignment of a previously mentioned customer, the event identifies the customer and the accepted plan supplies the vehicle. A typed binding query retrieves this relation and checks it against the current decision domain. The runtime enforces the resolved assignment during search. Events are added to the committed history after an update is accepted. Requests about earlier assignments use one saved plan from the preceding accepted state. The full Pareto set is stored separately. In the recorded runs, the saved plan is the first candidate returned by final NSGA-II selection.

重启选择器：估计重用风险。Restart selector: estimate reuse risk.

经过编译和少量输入检查后，运行时会总结公共数据、决策类型和目标的更改。该模型使用此摘要和可接受的历史记录来评估重用风险并推荐“Warm”或“Full”。其解释引用了更改的字段或声明，例如替换的有效订单、逆转的客观偏好或更改的机器容量和能源成本。算法After compilation and a small input check, the runtime summarizes changes to public data, decision types, and objectives. The model uses this summary and accepted history to assess reuse risk and recommend Warm or Full. Its explanation cites changed fields or declarations, such as replaced active orders, reversed objective preferences, or changed machine capacities and energy costs. Algorithm1验证所引用的变更和对每个提议原因的结构支持。verifies the cited changes and structural support for each proposed cause.

SupportedMechanisms⁡(Δt)\operatorname{SupportedMechanisms}(\Delta_{t})检查五个允许的原因中哪一个具有匹配的结构变化。例如，改变声明的决策段支持决策选择的替换；多个资源属性（例如 CPU 容量和能源成本）的变化支持资源相对有用性的变化。checks which of the five allowed causes have matching structural changes. For example, changing the declared decision segments supports replacement of decision choices; changes to multiple resource attributes, such as CPU capacity and energy cost, support a change in the relative usefulness of resources.ChangedFields⁡(Δt)\operatorname{ChangedFields}(\Delta_{t})列出实际更改的公共数据和程序声明，包括表值和成员资格、决策部分、目标和两个可编辑函数。因此lists the public data and program declarations that actually changed, including table values and membership, decision segments, objectives, and the two editable functions. ThusVV保留支持的原因和retains supported causes andCC保留经过验证的引用更改。附录retains verified cited changes. AppendixA.2指定五个原因及其结构测试。specifies the five causes and their structural tests.

Warm 将先前的群体和存档映射到修订后的决策，然后使用本地类型修复来优先考虑可行性并降低标量适应度的惩罚。修复后的候选人最多占人口的一半；剩下的人由新候选人填补。 Full 重新初始化每个候选者。两者都使用相同的后续求解器和停止规则； NSGA-II 分别比较目标。 Warm 还会在迁移和修复过程中评估候选者。Warm maps the preceding population and archive to the revised decisions, then uses local typed repair to prioritize feasibility and lower penalized scalar fitness. Repaired candidates fill at most half the population; fresh candidates fill the rest. Full initializes every candidate afresh. Both use the same subsequent solver and stopping rule; NSGA-II compares objectives separately. Warm additionally evaluates candidates during migration and repair.

验证和承诺。Validation and commitment.

运行时编译每个编辑，检查所需的函数接口，并执行一个小的输入示例。这些检查中的错误最多会触发The runtime compiles each edit, checks the required function interfaces, and executes a small input example. Errors in these checks trigger at mostBB模型修复尝试。然后，固定求解器运行并检查所需的输出字段和结构。失败会拒绝修订并保留先前的状态。通过的结果提交修改后的数据、工作台、接受的输出和搜索状态，然后附加接受的事件。保留评估对执行后保存的解决方案进行评分。 附录model repair attempts. The fixed solver then runs and checks the required output fields and structure. A failure rejects the revision and preserves the preceding state. A passing result commits the revised data, Workbench, accepted output, and search state, then appends the accepted event. Held-out evaluation scores the saved solution after execution. Both actions start from the same saved population with three search seeds. MAPLE selects Warm in all four cases. Adding tasks gives Warm an HV gain over Full of 0.708 in routing and 0.022 in cloud placement (Table4.4），使用原始评估规则和每个案例单独的汇总参考文献。), using the original evaluation rules and separate pooled references per case.

基于已更改表格单元格分数的规则与主帕累托序列上的 MAPLE 匹配，但在所有四个添加的测试中选择“完整”。数字规则重新评估旧候选者：使用旧标识符在重命名测试中选择 Full，而映射标识符首先使所有六个决策为 Warm（两个任务，三个种子）。附录A rule based on the fraction of changed table cells matches MAPLE on the main Pareto sequences but selects Full in all four added tests. A numerical rule re-evaluates old candidates: using old identifiers selects Full in the renaming tests, while mapping identifiers first makes all six decisions Warm (two tasks, three seeds). 5 相关工作Related Work

领域从业者的自然语言优化。Natural-language optimization for domain practitioners.NL4Opt 将语言映射到线性程序NL4Opt maps language to linear programs(Ramamonjison et al., 2023)。优化代理生成公式和求解器代码，使用执行反馈进行修订. Optimization agents generate formulations and solver code, using execution feedback for revision(AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2025; Thind et al., 2025)。 MIRROR 和 ORPilot 添加问题提示和操作数据处理. MIRROR and ORPilot add problem elicitation and operational data handling(Shi et al., 2026; Xie, 2026)。 MAPLE 支持随着操作的变化而持续修订。. MAPLE supports continued revision as operations change.

交互式和动态语言代理。Interactive and dynamic language agents.代理在交互过程中保留对话和经验Agents retain dialogue and experience across interactions(Yao et al., 2023)，记忆系统检索先前的信息, with memory systems retrieving prior information(Packer et al., 2023; Maharana et al., 2024)。 Flex-TravelPlanner 引入了多轮约束. Flex-TravelPlanner introduces constraints over multiple turns(Oh et al., 2025); Gaia2 测试改变环境的异步事件和操作; Gaia2 tests asynchronous events and actions that change the environment(Froger et al., 2026)。 MAPLE 保留可执行的优化状态，而 NLDO 评估跨修订的连续性和解决方案质量。. MAPLE retains executable optimization state, while NLDO evaluates continuity and solution quality across revisions.

多目标和动态数值优化。Multi-objective and dynamic numerical optimization.动态优化在不断变化的目标和约束下使用种群修复、转移和重新启动Dynamic optimization uses population repair, transfer, and restart under changing objectives and constraints(Branke, 2002; Nguyen et al., 2012)。 MOHOLLM 使用 LLM 代理模型和候选采样器进行分层多目标搜索. MOHOLLM uses LLM surrogate models and candidate samplers for hierarchical multi-objective search(Schwanke et al., 2026)。 MAPLE 通过语言修改可执行问题，然后运行 NSGA-II 等已建立的求解器. MAPLE revises executable problems through language, then runs established solvers such as NSGA-II(Deb et al., 2002).

6 结论Conclusion

MAPLE 在自然语言修订中维护可执行的优化状态。它完成了所有 15 条 NLDO 轨迹，在线标量质量为 0.951，Pareto HV 为 0.875。控制显示 TSS 减少了无效输出，并且某些历史请求需要更新记录和接受的计划。在中断性路由更改后，全新的初始化会有所帮助；修复后的候选项在重命名和任务添加控制中仍然有用。MAPLE maintains executable optimization state across natural-language revisions. It completes all 15 NLDO trajectories, with online scalar quality of 0.951 and Pareto HV of 0.875. Controls show that TSS reduces invalid outputs and that some historical requests require both update records and accepted plans. Fresh initialization helps after disruptive routing changes; repaired candidates remain useful in renaming and task-addition controls.

道德和可重复性。Ethics and reproducibility.

NLDO 使用合成数据。 该补充提供了任务、提示、设置、种子级证据和离线评分以及与代理输入分开的参考（附录NLDO uses synthetic data. The supplement provides tasks, prompts, settings, seed-level evidence, and offline scoring with references separate from agent inputs (AppendixA.10).

A.3 TSS 工作台和可用选项TSS Workbench and Available Choices

TSS Workbench 是一个可重复使用的优化程序。 一个小目录描述了工作台构建模型可用的决策类型和求解器，以及运行时可用的固定检查和重新启动操作。 该模型仅编辑决策定义函数和评估函数。 第一个读取公共表，声明类型化决策，选择求解器并命名输出。 第二个步骤根据公众的限制和目标来检查一名候选人。 表The TSS Workbench is a reusable optimization program. A small catalog describes the decision types and solvers available to the Workbench-building model, together with the fixed checks and restart actions available to the runtime. The model edits only the decision-definition function and the evaluation function. The first reads public tables, declares typed decisions, chooses the solver, and names the outputs. The second checks one candidate against the public constraints and objectives. Table7总结了这个边界。summarizes this boundary.

线性问题如何发送至求解器。How linear problems are sent to the solver.

工作台指定固定求解器的变量、边界、目标和线性约束。每个变量都有一个名称和一个连续或整数域。目标声明包括系数和方向。每个约束提供一个系数行、一个关系和一个右侧。 固定后端构建系数数组并通过 SciPy 的线性或混合整数求解器使用 HiGHS。 声明的提取规则将返回的值映射到选定的实体、分配或计划。 运行时验证该输出并保留求解器状态和目标。 该数值公式是在与数据访问代码相同的工作台构造调用中生成的。The Workbench specifies variables, bounds, the objective, and linear constraints for the fixed solver. Each variable has a name and a continuous or integer domain. The objective declaration includes coefficients and a direction. Each constraint supplies a coefficient row, a relation, and a right-hand side. The fixed backend builds the coefficient arrays and uses HiGHS through SciPy’s linear or mixed-integer solver. A declared extraction rule maps returned values to selected entities, assignments, or schedules. The runtime validates that output and retains the solver status and objective. This numerical formulation is produced within the same Workbench construction call as the data access code.

添加决策类型或求解器。Adding a decision type or solver.

每个目录条目指定其输入、输出、使用条件和可能的故障。 条目可以调用现有的求解器或重新启动策略。 添加决策类型需要实现其初始化、变化和修复运算符并将它们注册到目录中。Each catalog entry specifies its inputs, outputs, use conditions, and possible failures. An entry can call an existing solver or restart policy. Adding a decision type requires implementing its initialization, variation, and repair operators and registering them in the catalog.

TSS 拒绝无法用其声明的决策类型表达的决策空间。 求解器选择保留公共目标名称，并且不能将 Pareto 任务转变为标量任务。 Warm 将历史候选迁移到当前决策域并重新评估其可行性。 它会删除修复后的种子的重复数据，并用新的候选者填充剩余的填充槽。TSS rejects a decision space that cannot be expressed by its declared decision types. Solver selection preserves the public objective names and cannot turn a Pareto task into a scalar one. Warm migrates historical candidates into the current decision domains and re-evaluates their feasibility. It deduplicates the repaired seeds and fills the remaining population slots with fresh candidates.

搜索前修复多老的候选者。How old candidates are repaired before search.

Warm 首先使早期的候选者适应更新的决策并检查其可行性。这些候选人来自以前的人口和档案。 对于多个目标，种子排序包括客观极值、膝盖候选和拥挤的非支配选择。 首先将每个候选者迁移到当前域，然后进行评估。 本地搜索测试特定类型的动作并接受该对中的第一个改进Warm first adapts earlier candidates to the updated decisions and checks their feasibility. These candidates come from the previous population and archive. For multiple objectives, the seed ordering includes objective extremes, knee candidates, and nondominated selection with crowding. Each candidate is first migrated to the current domains, then evaluated. The local search tests type-specific moves and accepts the first improvement in the pair(𝟙​[infeasible],fscalar)(\mathbb{1}[\text{infeasible}],f_{\mathrm{scalar}})。 扫描后没有任何改进或评估了 80 个提案后，它会停止。 标量适应度包括生成的惩罚，而后续的 NSGA-II 循环保留单独的目标向量。 重复数据删除后，再次检查种子可行性以进行报告。返回的种子进入可行性优先搜索，剩余的槽重新采样。. It stops after a sweep with no improvement or 80 evaluated proposals. The scalar fitness includes the generated penalty, whereas the subsequent NSGA-II loop retains the separate objective vector. After deduplication, seed feasibility is checked again for reporting. The returned seeds enter feasibility-first search, and the remaining slots are sampled afresh.

由于人口数量为 200，历史候选者最多为 100，Warm 在共享进化循环之前使用了多达 8,200 个额外的评估调用。循环本身使用With population 200 and at most 100 historical candidates, Warm uses up to 8,200 additional evaluation calls before the shared evolutionary loop. The loop itself usesN⁡(g+1)N(g+1)呼吁人口规模calls for population sizeNN和andgg完成了几代人。舞台墙时间还包括初始化、修复和验证。completed generations. Stage wall time also includes initialization, repair, and validation.

A.4 局限性和道德规范Limitations and Ethics

MAPLE 依赖于决策类型、求解器路径和重新启动操作的固定目录。需要新决策类型或数值运算符的任务需要运行时扩展。类型化运算符保留表示成员资格，但可行性仍然取决于生成的评估函数。MAPLE relies on a fixed catalog of decision types, solver routes, and restart actions. Tasks requiring a new decision type or numerical operator need a runtime extension. Typed operators preserve representation membership, but feasibility still depends on the generated evaluation function.

LSM 在保留的事件和接受的结果中提供参考。当请求可能引用多个早期实体或未指定约束时，代理需要澄清。语义重启门同样取决于模型对更新的解释。LSM grounds references in retained events and accepted results. The agent needs clarification when a request could refer to several earlier entities or leaves a constraint unspecified. The semantic restart gate similarly depends on the model’s interpretation of the update.

进化路线在有限的预算内进行优化。修复保留的候选者会增加搜索之前的工作，因此重用和全新初始化之间的选择也取决于可用的延迟。The evolutionary routes optimize within finite budgets. Repairing retained candidates adds work before search, so the choice between reuse and fresh initialization also depends on the available latency.

当前的实现在应用程序进程中运行生成的 Python 函数。操作使用需要对文件、导入、凭据和网络访问进行更强的隔离。 MAPLE 用于批量或人工监督的重新优化。高影响力的决策应支持检查、人工批准和回滚。The current implementation runs generated Python functions in the application process. Operational use requires stronger isolation of files, imports, credentials, and network access. MAPLE is intended for batch or human-supervised re-optimization. High-impact decisions should support inspection, human approval, and rollback.

A.6 基准和评估详情Benchmark and Evaluation Details

NLDO 有五个配置文件，每个配置文件三集，涵盖既定的选择、调度、排班、路由和云放置设置NLDO has five profiles with three episodes each, spanning established selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-placement settings(Beasley, 1990; Brandimarte, 1993; Ceschia et al., 2018; Pillac et al., 2013; Erdoğan and Miller-Hooks, 2012; Bektaş and Laporte, 2011; Beloglazov et al., 2012)。紧凑标量任务使用精确引用，较大标量任务使用最著名的解决方案，Pareto 任务使用保留的存档。. Compact scalar tasks use exact references, larger scalar tasks use best-known solutions, and Pareto tasks use held-out archives.

所请求更新的效果。Effects of the requested updates.

我们通过可行性、候选人排名、目标规模或报告的诊断的变化来标记更新。更改的表并不总是意味着更改的最佳决策。将一个目标乘以与候选无关的正常数可以保留帕累托优势，而仅更改一台机器或车辆的系数可以对候选进行重新排序。仅在报告诊断中使用的截止日期与硬返回截止日期具有不同的作用。历史参考是单独的注释。We label updates by changes to feasibility, candidate rankings, objective scale, or reported diagnostics. A changed table does not always imply changed optimal decisions. Multiplying one objective by a candidate-independent positive constant preserves Pareto dominance, while changing a coefficient for only one machine or vehicle can reorder candidates. A deadline used only in a reported diagnostic has a different role from a hard return deadline. Historical reference is a separate annotation.

每个配置文件贡献 36 个更新。 180 项更新中有 30 项需要来自早期请求的信息。在所有更新中，第一段有 103 个措辞不同。排班、路由和云放置各产生 6 个颠覆性的 t11-t12 状态。所有表更改都保留初始列和列出的决策实体。Each profile contributes 36 updates. Thirty of the 180 updates require information from earlier requests. Across all updates, 103 first paragraphs have distinct wording. Rostering, routing, and cloud placement contribute six disruptive t11–t12 states each. All table changes retain the initial columns and listed decision entities.

如何对保存的路线和作业进行评分。How saved routes and assignments are scored.

我们使用以下公式重新计算已保存计划的目标。We recompute the objectives of saved plans using the formulas stated below.

路线行驶时间使用距离除以速度。速度降低 25% 会使受影响的行驶时间乘以Routing travel time uses distance divided by speed. Reducing speed by 25% multiplies the affected travel time by4/34/3，保持物理距离不变。 排放量总和路线距离乘以车辆排放率和碳乘数。 公共定义仅在到达指定订单时应用拥塞，并在以后对该订单进行编辑时保留其标识。 每条非空路线均在零时间离开当前停车场，并在车辆轮班结束时返回。等待订单的准备时间和服务持续时间均计入已用时间。延迟衡量超出软到期时间的服务启动时间。 软到期目标的减少请求直接适用于该目标。它可以早于准备时间，在这种情况下，最早的服务已经发生迟到。 例如，将 87 的软到期目标减少 50 得到 37。由于准备时间为 40，修改后的软到期时间为 37，最早的服务会产生三个单位的延迟。, leaving physical distance unchanged. Emissions sum route distance times vehicle emission rate and the carbon multiplier. The public definition applies congestion only on arrival at the named order, with its identity retained across later edits to that order. Every nonempty route leaves the current depot at time zero and returns by the vehicle’s shift end. Waiting until an order’s ready time and its service duration both count toward elapsed time. Lateness measures service-start time beyond the soft due time. A requested reduction of a soft due target applies to that target directly. It can precede the ready time, in which case the earliest service already incurs lateness. For example, reducing a soft due target of 87 by 50 gives 37. With a ready time of 40 and a revised soft due time of 37, the earliest service incurs three units of lateness.

云能源将每台已用机器的一笔闲置费用与分配的 CPU 需求乘以该机器的每 CPU 能源率相加，并按能源价格和碳强度进行缩放。 隐藏的评估器将不平衡衡量为Cloud energy sums one idle charge per used machine and the assigned CPU demand times that machine’s per-CPU energy rate, scaled by energy price and carbon intensity. The hidden evaluator measures imbalance as

B=100∑m∈ℳavail|um−u¯|,um=∑j:a⁡(j)=mcjCm,u¯=∑m∈ℳavailum|ℳavail|.B=100\sum_{m\in\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{avail}}}|u_{m}-\bar{u}|,\qquad u_{m}=\frac{\sum_{j:a(j)=m}c_{j}}{C_{m}},\qquad\bar{u}=\frac{\sum_{m\in\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{avail}}}u_{m}}{|\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{avail}}|}.

这里Herecjc_{j}是活动作业的 CPU 需求，is an active job’s CPU demand andCmC_{m}是机器容量。可用但未使用的机器的平均利用率为零。is machine capacity. Available but unused machines contribute zero utilization to the mean.

原始运行使用其生成的工作台函数进行搜索。主表使用上述公共公式对保存的计划重新评分。 原始隐藏路由评估器将传入距离、时间和排放乘以 1.25，并添加未声明的与负载相关的排放因子。 保存的生成补丁通过坐标识别受影响的客户，并使用不同的受影响腿范围（图The original runs searched with their generated Workbench functions. The original hidden cloud evaluator accumulates an energy charge after each assignment, making energy depend on dictionary order. For two jobs with CPU demands 2 and 4, idle energy 5, and per-CPU rate 2, this rule gives 26 or 30 depending on order, while the public formula gives 17 before global scaling. Energy is invariant to the order of keys in the returned assignment map. The original wording allowed variance or absolute deviation. The release now states this absolute-deviation formula explicitly in the initial request and every update. We re-score saved routes and assignments using the public formulas above and construct new common references under those formulas. The main agent comparison, the complete TSS ablation, and the full-sequence restart comparison use the public-formula evaluation. The single-update restart, search-operator, independent-model, and reference-sensitivity controls use the evaluation functions recorded in their original runs. We also checked all saved external Pareto outputs against the formal reference. Persistent ReAct’s old scores used embedded constructive reference sets on 30 feasible recorded rows, nine of which also retained objective vectors inconsistent with re-evaluation of the saved assignment maps. The primary tables recompute objectives from plans and use the common formal reference pool. Across 4,368 Pareto state–seed records, every originally eligible output remains mathematically feasible after re-evaluation. Sixteen additional saved outputs are feasible but outside their recorded strict prefix and receive zero strict-prefix quality.

A.8 基线接口和执行Baseline Interfaces and Execution

Persistent ReAct 保留的代码和计划。Code and plans retained by Persistent ReAct.

Persistent ReAct 保留其先前的求解器代码和接受的答案，然后编辑下一个请求的程序。是我们基于ReAct模式的有状态控制。在初始化时，模型使用公共参数和求解器库编写完整的 Python 求解器程序。在更新时，它接收初始公共表、累积对话及其携带的工作空间，然后发出修订后的程序，该程序在解决之前应用所请求的更改。Persistent ReAct retains its preceding solver code and accepted answer, then edits the program for the next request. It is our stateful control based on the ReAct pattern. At initialization, the model writes a complete Python solver program using public parameters and solver libraries. At an update it receives the initial public tables, cumulative dialogue, and its carried workspace, then emits the revised program, which applies the requested changes before solving.

运行时解析、编译并执行程序，然后读取其打印的解决方案。编译、运行时或解决方案格式失败会将实际错误和可用输出返回到模型，以进行最多三个代码输出修复。推理和工具计划字段是辅助输出。缺失的辅助字段会单独检查，并且不会在保存的运行中触发代码修复。The runtime parses, compiles, and executes the program, then reads its printed solution. Compilation, runtime, or solution-format failures return the actual error and available output to the model for at most three code-output repairs. The reasoning and tool-plan fields are auxiliary outputs. Missing auxiliary fields are checked separately and did not trigger code repair in the saved runs.

工作区保留了完整的先前求解器代码和紧凑的最终答案。单独的历史记录字段包含先前的计划和累积更新。提取的解决方案的公开执行成功推进了这一工作空间。 t00 处未携带任何内容。一个程序可能会在一个阶段内产生多个候选者和帕累托集；跨阶段工作区保留代码和答案，没有单独的总体或帕累托存档。The workspace retains the complete preceding solver code and a compact final answer. A separate history field contains the preceding plan and cumulative updates. Public execution success with an extracted solution advances this workspace. Nothing is carried at t00. A program may produce multiple candidates and a Pareto set within a stage; the cross-stage workspace retains code and answers, with no separate population or Pareto archive.

停止规则。Stopping rule.

主要进化运行最多在 200 代后停止。 从第 40 代开始，如果没有足够的改进，运行可能会在 25 代后停止。 标量运行需要上述相对改进Main evolutionary runs stop after at most 200 generations. From generation 40 onward, a run may stop after 25 generations without sufficient improvement. A scalar run requires a relative improvement above5×10−45\times 10^{-4}以其最佳可行的目标。 仅当至少有八个可行的档案成员时，帕累托运行才符合资格。 然后，运行的目标框固定为 5% 的上限。 内部高压增益高于 25 代计数后重新开始in its best feasible objective. A Pareto run becomes eligible only with at least eight feasible archive members. The run’s objective box is then fixed with a 5% upper margin. The 25-generation count restarts after an internal HV gain above5×10−45\times 10^{-4}。 在前面占据新的标准化宽度单元格后，它也会重新启动. It also restarts after the front occupies a new normalized cell of width0.010.01或将标准化理想点提高超过or improves the normalized ideal point by more than5×10−45\times 10^{-4}。 停止使用这些内部工作台信号。保留的 HV 和 IGD 是根据保存的候选者计算得出的，用于最终评分和世代图。. Stopping uses these internal Workbench signals. Held-out HV and IGD are computed from saved candidates for final scoring and generation-wise plots.

解释分配请求所需的信息。Information needed to interpret assignment requests.

我们会改变模型是否接收较早的更新记录、接受的计划、两者都接收或两者都不接收。我们在 t04、t08 和 t10 时使用 P010 中保存的路由状态和 P015 中的云放置状态。这些请求需要三种信息。一种是通过早期更新来识别所请求的分配。另一位则指出了相关实体的名字，并要求保留已接受计划中的任务。第三个使用较早的更新来识别实体和接受的计划来检索其分配。每种类型在每个领域都有 3 个等效词语，给出 18 种语言请求。We vary whether the model receives earlier update records, the accepted plan, both, or neither. We use saved routing states from P010 and cloud-placement states from P015 at t04, t08, and t10. The requests require three kinds of information. One kind identifies the requested assignment through earlier updates. Another names the relevant entities and asks to preserve assignments from the accepted plan. The third uses an earlier update to identify the entities and the accepted plan to retrieve their assignments. Each kind has three equivalent wordings in each domain, giving 18 language requests.

例如，第一路由请求将拥堵通知中识别的客户分配给排放更新中识别的车辆。第二个名字订购 O001、O002 和 O003 并保留其保存的车辆分配。第三个保留拥堵通知中标识的客户的已保存车辆分配。表For example, the first routing request assigns the customer identified in a congestion note to the vehicle identified in an emissions update. The second names orders O001, O002, and O003 and preserves their saved vehicle assignments. The third preserves the saved vehicle assignment of the customer identified in the congestion note. 第五个条件通过固定程序提供所需的分配。所需答案单独存储以供评估。A fifth condition supplies the required assignment through a fixed procedure. The required answers are stored separately for evaluation.

保存的语言测试和搜索重播中使用的计划。Saved plans used in the language tests and search replay.

原始语言测试和搜索重放使用按照不同规则选择的代表。语言测试读取从每个种子保存的档案中重建的代表。他们选择记录标量适应度最低的计划，并按存档顺序打破平局。最初的在线运行通过不同的规则选择其代表。它存储最终 NSGA-II 群体的第一个成员，按非支配等级、递减的拥挤距离和违规分数排序，具有稳定的关系。The original language tests and the search replay use representatives selected by different rules. The language tests read a representative reconstructed from each seed’s saved archive. They select the plan with the lowest recorded scalar fitness and break ties by archive order. The original online run selects its representative by a different rule. It stores the first member of the final NSGA-II population, ordered by nondomination rank, decreasing crowding distance, and violation score, with stable ties.

对于搜索重播，我们使用第一个措辞中保存的查询，并从最初导出的在线计划中读取作业。我们在五个信息条件中的每一个下运行六个具有三个搜索种子的案例。这会为每个条件提供 18 个数值结果，总共 90 个结果。每次搜索使用 200 个群体，最多 200 代。公共表、工作台、温暖选择、起始人口和搜索预算在不同条件下保持固定。所请求的分配是在重新启动群体构建之后施加的。For the search replay, we use the saved query from the first wording and read assignments from the originally exported online plan. We run six cases with three search seeds under each of the five information conditions. This gives 18 numerical results per condition and 90 results in total. Each search uses a population of 200 and at most 200 generations. The public tables, Workbench, Warm choice, starting population, and search budget are held fixed across conditions. The requested assignment is imposed after the restart population is built.

识别并执行所请求的任务。Identifying and enforcing the requested assignment.

我们在语言测试中评估作业识别，并在单独的搜索重放中评估作业执行。完整的 LSM 解决了所有 18 个请求。仅使用较早的更新记录，该模型即可解决这些记录可响应的六个请求。仅通过接受的计划，它就可以解决明确指定相关实体的六个请求。这两种情况都无法解决需要两种类型信息的六个请求。如果没有任何记录，则不会解决任何请求。提供的赋值条件直接返回所需的关系。We evaluate assignment identification in the language tests and assignment enforcement in a separate search replay. Full LSM resolves all 18 requests. With only earlier update records, the model resolves the six requests answerable from those records. With only the accepted plan, it resolves the six requests that explicitly name the relevant entities. Neither condition resolves the six requests that need both types of information. With neither record, no request is resolved. The supplied-assignment condition returns the required relation directly.

数值测试需要检索并执行正确的分配。返回档案中的每个计划都必须满足问题约束并保留该分配。作业丢失或不正确以及不可行的档案质量为零。完整的 LSM 和提供的分配控制各自产生 18 个有效结果，平均 HV 为 0.825。仅早期记录条件产生 6 个有效结果，平均 HV 为 0.261。仅接受计划条件产生六个有效结果，平均 HV 为 0.258。表The numerical test requires the correct assignment to be retrieved and enforced. Every plan in the returned archive must satisfy the problem constraints and preserve that assignment. Missing or incorrect assignments and infeasible archives receive zero quality. Full LSM and the supplied-assignment control each produce 18 valid results and mean HV of 0.825. The earlier-records-only condition produces six valid results and mean HV of 0.261. The accepted-plan-only condition produces six valid results and mean HV of 0.258. Table20将这些数值结果与原始语言测试分开。separates these numerical results from the original language tests.

重建计划与在线计划的比较。Comparison of reconstructed and online plans.

我们将重建代表中请求的作业与原始在线计划中的作业进行比较。重建的代表和原始在线计划在 18 个案例种子状态中有 12 个不同。在阅读已接受计划的十二个案例中，要求的作业有五个不同。差异出现在 P010（种子 0 和 1）中命名订单并保留其分配的请求中，以及使用 P015（种子 0-2）中的两条记录的请求中。所请求的作业在其他七种情况下一致。早期更新记录中答复的六个请求未读取已接受的计划。We compare the requested assignments in the reconstructed representatives with those in the original online plans. The reconstructed representative and the original online plan differ in 12 of the 18 case–seed states. Among the twelve cases that read an accepted plan, the requested assignments differ in five. The differences occur in the requests that name orders and preserve their assignments in P010 (seeds 0 and 1), and in the requests that use both records in P015 (seeds 0–2). The requested assignments agree in the other seven cases. The six requests answered from earlier update records do not read the accepted plan.

没有 TSS 的程序构建。Program construction without TSS.

如果没有 TSS，模型会定义自己的候选表示以及生成、评估、修改和修复候选的函数。它通过序列保留该程序。 在Without TSS, the model defines its own candidate representation and the functions that generate, evaluate, modify, and repair candidates. It retains this program through the sequence. Att00，模型接收公共问题和所需的工作台功能。 它不接收 TSS 决策类型、编码指导或特定于类型的搜索运算符。 它还定义了从候选到解决方案的数据加载和转换。 在“Warm”状态下，它只能修复其先前状态的解决方案。 LPD 仍然可以识别问题的哪一部分发生了变化。 LSM 仍然提供存储的事件、方法自己的接受状态及其搜索档案。 固定优化循环仍然总结更改，应用相同的重新启动选择器，执行选择，维护存档，检查停止并格式化输出。 编译、公开验证和修复限制不变。 此控件将类型化表示、特定于类型的运算符和受限编辑界面一起删除。, the model receives the public problem and the required Workbench functions. It receives no TSS decision types, encoding guidance, or type-specific search operators. It also defines data loading and conversion from a candidate to a solution. Under Warm, it can repair only solutions from its own preceding state. LPD still identifies which part of the problem changed. LSM still supplies stored events, the method’s own accepted state, and its search archives. The fixed optimization loop still summarizes the change, applies the same restart selector, performs selection, maintains the archive, checks stopping, and formats the output. Compilation, public validation, and the repair limit are unchanged. This control removes the typed representation, type-specific operators, and restricted editing interface together.

A.16 通过交互式界面使用 MAPLEUsing MAPLE through an Interactive Interface

该界面允许用户提交规划请求、检查解决方案并修改相同的问题。该应用程序称为 MAPLE Harness。每个会话都会保留工作台、候选人计划、目标跟踪以及跨更新的重新启动操作。 图The interface lets users submit a planning request, inspect the solutions, and revise the same problem. The application is called MAPLE Harness. Each session retains the Workbench, candidate plans, objective traces, and restart actions across updates. Figure12显示已发布的演练中的 CNC 调度会话，与 NLDO 分开。shows a CNC scheduling session from the published walkthrough, separate from NLDO.

该接口将规划请求发送到通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 运行 MAPLE 的单独服务。每个请求都会返回一个作业标识符，界面使用该标识符来显示搜索进度。接受结果后，服务将保存更新的会话。用户可以检查解决方案并将其导出为 CSV 或 JSON。The interface sends planning requests to a separate service that runs MAPLE through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Each request returns a job identifier, which the interface uses to display search progress. After the result is accepted, the service saves the updated session. Users can inspect the solutions and export them as CSV or JSON.

NLDO-P010（NLDO；green_vrp_multiobjective）NLDO-P010 (NLDO; green_vrp_multiobjective)

 

最初的公众请求。Initial public request.为小型城市车队规划从单个仓库出发的当日送货路线。公共 CSV 表中提供了初始仓库、车辆和订单数据。使用附加的仓库、车辆、订单和政策表作为事实来源。所有有效订单均应在车辆容量下送达一次。 active=false 的行是公共候选订单，在稍后的自然语言更新显式激活它们之前不会提供服务。后续更新可能会取代公共秩序几何、需求、时间窗口、优先级、车辆排放、车站坐标或碳政策；所有当前行仍然是公开的。使用公共政策参数（如果存在）优化三个主要标准：出行距离、配送延迟和排放。还报告路线中断和优先客户处罚作为辅助诊断。Plan same-day delivery routes from a single depot for a small urban fleet. Initial depot, vehicle, and order data are provided in public CSV tables. Use the attached depot, vehicle, order, and policy tables as the source of truth. All active orders should be served once under vehicle capacity. Rows with active=false are public candidate orders that are not served until a later natural-language update explicitly activates them. Later updates may replace public order geometry, demand, time windows, priorities, vehicle emissions, depot coordinates, or carbon policy; all current rows remain public. Optimize three main criteria: travel distance, delivery lateness, and emissions using public policy parameters when present. Also report route disruption and priority-customer penalties as auxiliary diagnostics.

  • t01 D

    在现有作业 J003、J004、J005、J006、J007 中识别出延迟敏感工作负载组burst-2。将其公共优先级增加 1 并记住该组名称以供以后更新。工作表保持固定。A latency-sensitive workload group burst-2 is identified among existing jobs J003, J004, J005, J006, J007. Increase their public priority by 1 and remember this group name for later updates. The job table remains fixed.

  • t02 O

    由于热节流，机器 M04 的 energy_per_cpu 增加了 0.055，但其 CPU 和内存容量保持不变。Machine M04’s energy_per_cpu increases by 0.055 because of thermal throttling, but its CPU and memory capacity stay unchanged.

  • t03 D

    作业 J007 的软 SLA 目标在升级后收紧了 35 分钟。这会影响延迟损失，而不是硬可行性。Soft SLA target for job J007 is tightened by 35 minutes after an escalation. This affects latency penalty, not hard feasibility.

  • t04 R

    下一个控制窗口的能源价格将翻倍，因此能源成本变得更加重要。Energy price doubles for the next control window, so energy cost becomes much more important.

  • t05 日、中D,M

    开头提到的工作负载突发现在获得高级优先级 5；从记忆中推断出受影响的工作。The workload burst mentioned at the beginning now gets premium priority 5; infer the affected jobs from memory.

  • t06 O

    碳感知操作窗口启动：机器 M06 的 energy_idle 增加 1.6，carbon_intensity 升至 1.80，energy_price 设置为 1.25。这改变了能量与平衡的权衡，而无需改变机器组或容量。A carbon-aware operating window starts: machine M06’s energy_idle increases by 1.6, carbon_intensity rises to 1.80, and energy_price is set to 1.25. This changes the energy-versus-balance trade-off without changing the machine set or capacities.

  • t07 D

    现有的类似分析的作业 J020 变得不那么紧急：将其优先级降低 1，并将其软 SLA 目标延长 25 分钟。活动作业集保持固定。Existing analytics-like job J020 becomes less urgent: reduce its priority by 1 and extend its soft SLA target by 25 minutes. The active job set remains fixed.

  • t08 R

    稀缺窗口后会出现平衡指令：energy_price 下降至 0.70，而carbon_intensity 仍保持在 1.35 的高位。该计划现在应该实现更好的负载平衡，而不是简单地最小化能源。A balancing directive follows the scarcity window: energy_price drops to 0.70 while carbon_intensity remains elevated at 1.35. The plan should now expose better load balance instead of simply minimizing energy.

  • t09 R

    运营部门通过将其软 SLA 目标延长 30 分钟来放松分析作业 J020，并将 Carbon_intensity 设置为 1.10。Operations relaxes the analytics job J020 by extending its soft SLA target by 30 minutes, and carbon_intensity is set to 1.10.

  • t10 O

    较晚的重置会改变相同工作的能源和服务优先级。机器M04的energy_per_cpu减少0.04；机器M07的energy_idle增加2.2； energy_price 设置为 0.60，carbon_intensity 设置为 0.85。现有作业 J012、J013、J014、J015、J016 获得优先级 +1，软 SLA 目标收紧 20 分钟。客观的权衡已经发生了变化，但目前的可行性仍然是根据相同的固定公共资源和工作集来判断的。A late reset changes energy and service priorities over the same jobs. Machine M04’s energy_per_cpu is reduced by 0.04; machine M07’s energy_idle increases by 2.2; energy_price is set to 0.60 and carbon_intensity to 0.85. Existing jobs J012, J013, J014, J015, J016 receive priority +1 and soft SLA targets tightened by 20 minutes. The objective trade-off has moved, but current feasibility is still judged over the same fixed public resource and job set.
